scope: Create a reviewable normal two-parent merge of exact canonical main into the paused exact ECO head, prove the candidate removes aggregate ECO PC0 RED without a runtime tree delta, open a draft PR targeting ECO, and stop before that PR is merged.
required_outputs: Pre-merge RED and synthetic post-merge NON_RED reports
stop_conditions: origin/main, ECO source, passport blob, or source dry-merge tree moves at any point through merge creation, verification, evidence, review, draft PR, or human merge
Merge conflict or non-control tree delta appears
Synthetic standard PC0 remains RED or directional PC0 becomes RED
Any runtime, passport, ecology, registry, or architecture edit is required
CONTROL_DOCS_ONLY_MERGE approval has not been granted
risk_reasons: Dependency integration changes ECO branch ancestry and PC0 critical-drift evaluation.
A false synthetic non-RED verdict could incorrectly unblock H0.0.
The candidate has no runtime tree delta and changes no ownership, identity, or foundation contract, so CRITICAL triggers are absent.

design_brief.problem_statement: ECO is now paused at 67e23224, but its merge-base with main remains 790fd79f. Its copied registry content cannot remove the resulting critical dependency-drift RED.
design_brief.current_behavior: Live pre-merge PC0 is RED for ECO because canonical main 5ba1dcb7 is not in ECO ancestry, while the source dry merge already proves that integrating main needs no tree change.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A normal two-parent merge of exact main 5ba1dcb7 into a durable control head descended from exact ECO 67e23224 updates ancestry without merge-induced runtime or passport tree delta. A synthetic exact ref at that merge must make aggregate PC0 NON_RED while directional findings remain YELLOW/non-critical.
alternatives_considered: Create a normal-merge draft PR into ECO
design_brief.selected_design: Use a replacement control branch from the exact paused ECO head, persist reviewed control records, pin the final pre-merge control head, create a no-fast-forward normal merge with that head first and exact main second, verify synthetic remote topology in a clean clone, and open a draft PR targeting ECO.
design_brief.why_selected: The normal merge preserves recovery history, integrates canonical ancestry instead of copying files, avoids force-push, and gives the ECO owner a zero-runtime-delta candidate to approve.
non_goals: No ECO runtime or research edit
validation_plan: Fetch and require exact main/ECO/passport/tree identities before merge creation, synthetic PC0, evidence, exact review, draft PR, and human merge.
Record live pre-merge PC0 RED as expected diagnosis, not candidate failure.
Pin the exact pre-merge control head; prove its first-parent ancestry contains the exact ECO source and its source delta contains only allowed control records.
Create a normal two-parent merge; assert parents are exact pre-merge head then exact main, and candidate tree equals immediate first-parent tree.
Prove source dry-merge tree equals original ECO tree and source-to-candidate changes avoid runtime, passport, registry, and architecture surfaces.
In a fresh URL clone, set only a disposable synthetic ECO remote-tracking ref to the exact candidate while keeping origin/main exact; run standard and directional PC0.
Require standard aggregate NON_RED and directional no RED critical hit; perform independent exact-head review and verification before draft PR.
Open only a draft PR targeting ECO and stop in WAITING_HUMAN for CONTROL_DOCS_ONLY_MERGE.

notes: R1 remains terminal EPOCH_INVALIDATED because ECO moved after dispatch. R2 starts only after the user-confirmed pause and retains a fail-closed lifecycle freshness rule.
